在 AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.java 中

写法

com/byzh/diverse_draw/item/custom/ModFuelItem.java:

package com.byzh.diverse_draw.item.custom;

import net.minecraft.world.item.Item;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.item.crafting.RecipeType;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

public class ModFuelItem extends Item {

    private int burnTime = 0; // 单位是 tick

    public ModFuelItem(Properties pProperties, int BurnTime) {
        super(pProperties);
        this.burnTime = BurnTime;
    }

    // 重写 (这个方法来自 Item 的 IForgeItem接口, 是forge的扩展方法: 用于设置物品的燃烧时间)
    @Override
    public int getBurnTime(ItemStack itemStack, @Nullable RecipeType<?> recipeType) {
        return burnTime;
    }
}

IForgeItem接口内有很多很棒的方法

item.title: [forge-1.20.1] 6.数据生成
item.author: xxx@example.com (byzh)
item.description:
[forge-1.20.1] 6.数据生成

作者：byzh（xxx@example.com）

数据生成

总生成文件ModDataGenerator 

package com.byzh.diverse_draw;

import com.byzh.diverse_draw.datagen.*;
import net.minecraft.core.HolderLookup;
import net.minecraft.data.DataGenerator;
import net.minecraft.data.PackOutput;
import net.minecraft.data.loot.LootTableProvider;
import net.minecraft.world.level.storage.loot.parameters.LootContextParamSets;
import net.minecraftforge.common.data.BlockTagsProvider;
import net.minecraftforge.common.data.ExistingFileHelper;
import net.minecraftforge.data.event.GatherDataEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.eventbus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.fml.common.Mod;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;

@Mod.EventBusSubscriber(modid = DiverseDraw.MODID, bus = Mod.EventBusSubscriber.Bus.MOD)
public class ModDataGenerator {
    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void gatherData(GatherDataEvent event) {
        DataGenerator generator = event.getGenerator();

        // forge三工具
        // - 数据包输出路径的封装类
        // - 检查和引用已经存在的资源文件
        // - 注册表查找提供器
        PackOutput packOutput = generator.getPackOutput();
        ExistingFileHelper existingFileHelper = event.getExistingFileHelper();
        CompletableFuture<HolderLookup.Provider> lookupProvider = event.getLookupProvider();

        // 服务端:
        // - 配方
        // - 战利品
        // - 方块标签
        // - 物品标签 (同时也会自动注册方块对应的方块物品标签)
        generator.addProvider(event.includeServer(), new ModRecipeProvider(packOutput));
        generator.addProvider(event.includeServer(), new LootTableProvider(packOutput, Set.of(), List.of(
                new LootTableProvider.SubProviderEntry(ModBlockLootTableProvider::new, LootContextParamSets.BLOCK)
        )));
        BlockTagsProvider blockTagsProvider = generator.addProvider(event.includeServer(),
                new ModBlockTagProvider(packOutput, lookupProvider, existingFileHelper));
        generator.addProvider(event.includeServer(), new ModItemTagProvider(packOutput, lookupProvider, blockTagsProvider.contentsGetter(), existingFileHelper));

        // 客户端:
        // - 方块状态
        // - 物品模型
        // - 语言文件
        generator.addProvider(event.includeClient(), new ModBlockStateProvider(packOutput, existingFileHelper));
        generator.addProvider(event.includeClient(), new ModItemModelProvider(packOutput, existingFileHelper));
        generator.addProvider(event.includeClient(), new ModLangEnUsProvider(packOutput));
        generator.addProvider(event.includeClient(), new ModLangZhCnProvider(packOutput));
    }
}

-> 然后运行 Gradle/Tasks/forgegradle runs/runData

item.title: [forge-1.20.1] 2.创作模式物品栏
item.author: xxx@example.com (byzh)
item.description:
[forge-1.20.1] 2.创作模式物品栏

作者：byzh（xxx@example.com）

创作模式物品栏[CreativeModeTab]

com/byzh/diverse_draw/item/ModCreativeModeTabs 

package com.byzh.diverse_draw.item;

import com.byzh.diverse_draw.DiverseDraw;
import net.minecraft.core.registries.Registries;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.world.item.CreativeModeTab;
import net.minecraft.world.item.CreativeModeTabs;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.item.Items;
import net.minecraftforge.eventbus.api.IEventBus;
import net.minecraftforge.registries.DeferredRegister;
import net.minecraftforge.registries.RegistryObject;

public class ModCreativeModeTabs {
    // 延迟注册器
    public static final DeferredRegister<CreativeModeTab> CREATIVE_MODE_TABS =
            DeferredRegister.create(Registries.CREATIVE_MODE_TAB, DiverseDraw.MODID);

    // 使用`延迟注册器`注册一个对象
    public static final RegistryObject<CreativeModeTab> Diverse_Draw_TAB =
            CREATIVE_MODE_TABS.register("diverse_draw", () -> CreativeModeTab.builder()
                    .icon(() -> new ItemStack(Moditems.ICE_ETHER.get()))
                    .title(Component.translatable("itemGroup.diverse_draw")) // 翻译的键
                    .displayItems((pParameters, pOutput) -> {
                        pOutput.accept(Moditems.ICE_ETHER.get());
                        pOutput.accept(Moditems.RAW_ICE_ETHER.get());
                    })
                    .build()
            );
    // 使用`延迟注册器`注册一个对象
    public static final RegistryObject<CreativeModeTab> MATERIAL_TABS =
            CREATIVE_MODE_TABS.register("material", () -> CreativeModeTab.builder()
                    .icon(() -> new ItemStack(Moditems.CARDBOARD.get()))
                    .title(Component.translatable("itemGroup.material")) // 翻译的键
                    .displayItems((pParameters, pOutput) -> {
                        pOutput.accept(Moditems.CARDBOARD.get());
                        pOutput.accept(Items.DIAMOND); // 其实也可以加原版的这些东西
                    })
                    .withTabsBefore(Diverse_Draw_TAB.getKey()) // 用于调整前后显示位置
                    .build()
            );

    public static void register(IEventBus eventBus) {
        CREATIVE_MODE_TABS.register(eventBus);
    }

}
  • 物品的各种属性都存在 ItemStack 这个容器里, 物品的 Item 本身不存这些
  • Component.translatable 会去查看 lang 里面的具体内容
  • Items.DIAMOND 是原版的物品, 本身就是 Item 类型 -> 符合 pOutput.accept 的输入类型, 不需要 .get()
  • Moditems.CARDBOARD 是自己创建的物品, 是 RegistryObject<Item> 类型 -> 不符合 pOutput.accept 的输入类型, 需要 .get() 获得其内的 Item 类型
